Behind the wheel is the heavy, rusted metal frame of the plow. To the right, a curved, wedge-shaped metal blade (the share/moldboard) is visible, partially embedded in or resting on the soil. The background consists of dense green foliage and trees.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the tire rubber appears slightly smudged and lacks the crisp, fine-grained detail of real rubber, particularly where the tread meets the sidewall. It has a slight 'painted' look rather than molded rubber.

The connection between the wheel rim and the axle/frame is visually ambiguous. The bolts/lug nuts are indistinct blobs, and the mechanical logic of how the wheel attaches to the rusted frame is not clearly defined, suggesting minor structural melting.
The leaves in the background exhibit a repetitive, patterned blur that feels slightly unnatural, typical of AI-generated backgrounds trying to simulate depth of field.
